title: India Climbs 5 Slots to 91st on Corruption Perception Index 2025
summary: India ranks 91st out of 180 countries with a score of 39/100 on Transparency International's CPI 2025.

blocks.content: India improved its rank from 96th to **91st globally (score 39/100)** on Transparency International's Corruption Perception Index 2025 (Denmark ranked 1st for 8th straight year).

provenance.sourceTitle: India Climbs 5 Slots to 91st on Corruption Perception Index 2025
